description: Secondary upload path for a small paste. Prefer get_upload_link and the hosted /upload page. Runs the same ingestion pipeline and returns hands parsed, tournaments parsed, and errors. Does not grade solver frequencies.

filename.description: Name to record for the paste. Defaults to "paste.txt".

text.description: Raw hand history or tournament summary text.

name: upload_hand_history

outputSchema.description: Result of ingesting one pasted hand history.

persisted.description: Always false: nothing is written to durable storage.

sessionId.description: Session id for the stored hands, or null when nothing parsed.

title: Upload a hand history
